name: Name
overview: Your packages. Your infrastructure. One control plane.
unlimited: No license-based limits on repositories, packages, users or daily requests. Actual capacity depends on your infrastructure.
securityNote: Publishing and deletion always require authentication and repository permissions.
groupNote: Select repositories of the same format. Reading a group also requires read access to its members.
deleteWarning: This action cannot be undone. Enter the exact name to confirm.
protocolUpload: Direct upload supports Raw and Maven. Use the package client for other formats.
tokenNote: This token is shown only once. Store it securely before closing this dialog.
label: Label
passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. Leave blank when editing to keep the current password.
systemNote: Read-only server configuration. Change environment variables and restart the service to apply updates.
compactHelp: Create a snapshot and compact the transaction log. Package files are not deleted.
verifyHelp: Recalculate SHA-256 hashes to detect missing or damaged files. Large repositories may take longer.
gcHelp: Only unreferenced blobs older than 24 hours are considered. Always run the preview first.
maintainNote: Create a verified backup before maintenance. This is a single-node deployment.
tokenHelp: Tokens inherit your account permissions. Use a separate least-privilege account for CI.
clientNote: Set GR_TOKEN in your environment instead of placing secrets in commands. Network deployments require HTTPS.
loginSubtitle: Sign in to your delivery workspace.
loginIntroTitle: Every artifact. Every decision. Accounted for.
loginIntroText: A self-hosted delivery workspace that connects package storage with release decisions and verifiable evidence.
footer: Artifacts under control. Decisions on record.
networkError: Cannot reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
invalidResponse: The server returned an unexpected response.
unexpectedError: The operation could not be completed.
offlineTranslations: Unable to load this language. English remains available.
repositoryNameHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens; up to 100 characters.
dockerHostedOnly: Docker / OCI currently supports hosted repositories only.
noUploadRepository: Create a hosted Raw or Maven repository to upload a file here.
confirmNameMismatch: The confirmation name does not match.
invalidPermissions: Enter a valid JSON object for repository permissions.
permissionsHelp: Example: {"raw-hosted":["read","write","approve"]}. Use approve for reviewers; write alone cannot approve releases.
invalidExpiry: Choose a valid expiration time in the future.
copyManual: Copy the selected text with Ctrl+C or Cmd+C.
noRepositories: Create your first repository to get started.
proxyReadOnly: Proxy and group repositories are read-only. Publish to a hosted repository.
clientDocs: More examples are included in the project documentation.
netrcComment: Configure .netrc for authenticated downloads; see the client guide.
passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in again. Existing tokens have been revoked.
passwordRotationHelp: Changing your password ends existing sessions and revokes your tokens.
emptyLanguage: English is used when no language is selected.

atlasOverview: A clear view of your artifacts, release decisions and storage.
atlasHeroText: Capture exact artifacts, record an independent review and deliver an immutable release with verifiable evidence.
firstCapsuleText: Choose artifacts in the explorer, then capture them together as a release capsule.
retainedFootprint: {bytes} in visible live and pinned content.
noSecurityScore: These are operational signals, not a vulnerability scan or a security rating.
releasesIntro: Immutable snapshots move through explicit, recorded decisions. No package copying between lanes.
lanePageNote: Lane counts refer to this page of results.
logicalLanesNote: Lanes represent governance state. They do not publish packages into another registry or promote package-manager metadata.
freezeDescription: A capsule pins the exact SHA-256 content. Existing files are not copied, and the captured manifest cannot be edited.
artifactReferencesHelp: One registry/path per line. Add artifacts from the explorer or paste references here. Read and write permission are required on every source.
assetReference: Use a valid registry/path on each line; traversal and encoded paths are not accepted.
duplicateAsset: The same artifact reference appears more than once.
addedToCapsule: Selection contains {count} artifacts. Use Create capsule to continue.
pinnedDownloadHelp: These downloads resolve the captured bytes, not the current content of the original registry paths.
historicalEvidenceNote: A signed receipt proves a past decision. Check the online gate for current revocation and quarantine. Signatures do not prove that packages are vulnerability-free.
gateResult: {count} unique digests checked; {drift} source paths changed since capture.
decisionDescription: This decision is recorded with your identity. The author cannot approve their own release, even as an administrator.
concurrencyNote: A changed revision rejects this request. Reload and review the latest state before retrying.
insightsIntro: Measured storage accounting and actionable configuration signals. No invented cost savings or security scores.
deduplicationExplanation: Identical SHA-256 content is referenced instead of stored repeatedly. This ratio compares live logical bytes with unique live bytes.
storageAccountingNote: Reference totals exclude WAL, metadata, temporary files and unreferenced blobs. Host free space is a separate file-system measurement.
noConfigurationSignals: No signals from the currently implemented checks.
signalHelp.MUTABLE_REPOSITORY: Use immutable snapshots for release delivery; live package paths may change.
signalHelp.PUBLIC_DOWNLOADS: Confirm that public distribution is intentional. This signal is not automatically a vulnerability.
signalHelp.OFFLINE_CACHE: Only cached content is available. New remote dependencies will not be fetched.
signalHelp.HELD_CONTENT: Inspect the containment queue and release gates before deployment.
signalHelp.PINNED_HISTORY: Garbage collection intentionally preserves release snapshots, including revoked history.
signalHelp.DISK_PRESSURE: Less than 15% of the file system is available. Review capacity and backups.
quarantineIntro: Contain a known content digest across every file alias, registry and pinned release.
manualNotScanner: Manual containment, not automated CVE scanning. A hold blocks future binary downloads; package metadata may remain visible.
quarantineScopeNote: Holds are digest-wide and survive restart. Downloads already in progress are not recalled or interrupted.
digestScopeWarning: This affects every artifact with this SHA-256, including content in other registries. Use an explicit, reviewable reason.
error.CONTENT_HELD: This content digest is quarantined. Contact an administrator.
error.RELEASE_EXISTS: This release name and version already exist.
error.STALE_RELEASE: The release changed. Reload before making a decision.
error.SELF_APPROVAL: A second person must approve this release.
error.RELEASE_TRANSITION: This action is not allowed for the current release and identity.
error.RELEASE_INTEGRITY: A captured artifact is missing, quarantined or fails verification.
error.NO_EVIDENCE: Signed evidence is issued when the release is published.
error.RELEASE_NOT_AVAILABLE: Only released, non-revoked snapshots can be downloaded.
error.RELEASE_REFERENCE: A release snapshot references this registry. Deletion is blocked.
